page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-4-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. The instance includes local NVMe SSD storage, though the exact capacity is not specified in the hardware profile. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a high memory-to-CPU ratio, positioning it as a memory-optimized option within its class. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage provides low-latency disk access, which is beneficial for workloads requiring fast temporary storage, though users must manage data persistence tradeoffs inherent to local drives.

This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel CPU processing, such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, in-memory analytics, and backend web applications with moderate compute requirements.
